values.text: The AFC09-30-01-55 is a 3-pole - 690 V IEC or 600 V UL contactor with 1 N.C built-in auxiliary contact and Screw terminals, mainly controlling power circuits up to 4 kW / 400 V AC (AC-3) or 5 hp / 480 V AC UL and 25 A (AC-1) or 25 A UL general use. Within the AF platform, AFC contactors offer an optimized operating time for AC controlled applications with electromagnetic coil (control voltage : 500V50Hz 600V60Hz). AFC contactors have a block type design and can be easily extended with add-on auxiliary contact blocks and a wide range of additionnal accessories.
